description:
What OTHER people changed in a project — the user in any R3 tab, their other agents — oldest first, grouped per author and per thing: properties set, code and help updated (with versions), components added, deleted or restored, the project renamed. Your own changes are never listed. Every answer about a project already ends with a short "Since your last call" line; this is its full list.

Without `since`: from where you last looked (and moves that mark to now, unless advance: false). The mark belongs to your agent key or app connection, not to the conversation: two conversations on one share it. With `since` (a seq, e.g. the one the "+N more" line names, or 0 for everything still in the log): from there, without moving anything. Needs project:read.

advance.description: Without since: move your mark to now (default true). false reads without moving it.

limit.description: At most this many groups, the newest (default 50, at most 200); the rest are counted.

since.description: List from this seq on (the "+N more" line names it; 0 = everything the log still holds).

name: r3_project_changes

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: List what others changed in a project
